triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: Alyosha had till the evening before implicitly believed that Katerina Ivanovna had a steadfast and passionate love for Dmitri

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: Madame Hohlakov’s blunt and persistent assertion that Katerina Ivanovna was in love with Ivan

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Dmitri had said outright on the previous day that he was glad that Ivan was his rival, and that it was a great assistance to him, Dmitri.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: Dmitri had said outright on the previous day that he was glad that Ivan was his rival, and that it was a great assistance to him, Dmitri.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: “One reptile will devour the other,” Ivan had pronounced the day before, speaking in anger of his father and Dmitri.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: by the side of two such friends as you and your brother I still feel strong—for I know—you two will never desert me.

triples.subject: Ivan Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: I am too young and I’ve loved you too much. I know that I ought not to say this, that it would be more dignified on my part simply to leave you

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: desire to assist him from me, Dmitri Fyodorovitch’s betrothed, not from himself....

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: What I see is that perhaps you don’t love Dmitri at all ... and never have, from the beginning.... And Dmitri, too, has never loved you

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: For you’re torturing Ivan, simply because you love him—and torturing him, because you love Dmitri through ‘self-laceration’

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch
triples.quote: Dmitri Fyodorovitch somehow lost his temper with this captain, seized him by the beard and dragged him out into the street

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: She had two hundred-rouble notes in her hand.

triples.subject: Snegiryov
triples.quote: He lives in Lake Street, in the house of a woman called Kalmikov....

triples.subject: Madame Hohlakov
triples.quote: “Mamma, you are spoiling him,” Lise’s little voice cried from behind the door.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: I somehow fancied all at once,” Alyosha went on as though he had not heard Lise, “that she loved Ivan, and so I said that stupid thing....

triples.subject: Yulia
triples.quote: Run and say, Yulia, that I’ll fly to her. As for Ivan Fyodorovitch’s going away like that, it’s her own fault.
